author: Krono II
title: PPO with SOTA Architecture (v2 - RNN Fix)
abstract: This submission corrects a critical bug in my previous PPO implementation (ID 283). The original training step failed to handle the recurrent nature of the SOTA architecture, resulting in a score of 0.0. This version integrates the correct sequential processing logic for RNNs and re-tests the PPO hypothesis.
